scripts.build:standalone: next build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('public', '.next/standalone/public', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('.next/static', '.next/standalone/.next/static', {recursive: true});"
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000/api npm run build:standalone && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:headed: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000/api npm run build:standalone && playwright test --headed
scripts.test:e2e:docs: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000/api npm run build:standalone && playwright test e2e/docs-capture.spec.ts
